page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.12xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance features 48 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, providing 48 vCPUs. It is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The underlying virtualization is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

This server configuration does not include local storage, requiring network-attached storage options for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps. From a resource density perspective, the combination of dedicated high-frequency Intel Xeon cores and a substantial memory allocation offers a robust hardware profile for workloads requiring consistent compute performance without hyperthreading interference, balanced with high memory capacity.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated core allocation, the ecs.hfr7.12xlarge is suited for memory-intensive applications, high-performance computing tasks, database hosting, and enterprise applications that benefit from high clock speeds and dedicated physical execution units without multi-threading overhead.
